colourstrue-g3-mode-banks.title: ColoursTrue LG G3 picture-mode catalogue and calibration-bank separation
colourstrue-g3-mode-banks.use: Catalogue updated 2026-08-02, referencing r98 bank probes and r100/r101 mode selection evidence.
